_help: EMERGENCY HOLD. To take the construction-camera photo and timelapse video down immediately, change "hold" to true and commit this file (GitHub: pencil icon > edit > Commit changes). The site updates within a few minutes. To resume, change it back to false and commit. Everything captured while on hold is permanently skipped. OPTIONAL: set "exclude_from" to an earlier time (e.g. "2026-10-08T14:20:00-06:00", or just "2026-10-08T14:20:00" for Mountain time) to also skip footage from BEFORE you flipped the switch.
